text: SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(pts) AS total_points, SUM(played) AS games_played, SUM(pts) * 1.0 / SUM(played) AS points_per_game FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats" WHERE game_date >= '2017-01-01' AND game_date < '2018-01-01' AND played = 1 GROUP BY player_id, player_name HAVING SUM(played) >= 20 ORDER BY points_per_game DESC LIMIT 10
